display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-07-D3-26 Advanced Distribution Management Systems (ADSM) for more efficient and flexible distribution grids – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-07-D3-26 Advanced Distribution Management Systems (ADSM) for more efficient and flexible distribution grids
executive_summary: Develops distribution-grid management software, forecasting and flexible-resource controls that can exchange data with transmission operators and distributed assets. Eligible consortium beneficiaries can receive up to 70% for for-profit beneficiaries under Horizon Europe. The indicative topic budget is EUR 28.5 million, with around EUR 9.5 million expected per project. Opening 2027-08-04, full proposal deadline 2027-12-01 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Work Programme Part 8, pp. 176–178, Scope and Specific conditions, funds this work, which connects to Grids & Benefits. The scope encourages an adjacent TSO and expects three DSOs plus two universities or research organisations. A funded Dutch TSO can join without substituting for any expected DSO, subject to the China-control restriction. The funded consortium role supports Type 1 and C1.3. Both project dates are null because the call states no start, end or duration.
